body.statement: For the full scores from def:full-score-covariance, including the harmonic translation score and the covariance between the leading and generated-target responses within each control cell, \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\lVert\Sigma_{h_n}(P)-V(P)\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\), where \(V(P)=\operatorname{diag}(V_1,\ldots,V_J)\), \(V_j=w_j\sqrt{\det H(y_j)}H(y_j)/(4\pi f_{T1}(y_j))\), and \(w_j=\alpha(y_j)(\rho_{C0}^{-1}+\rho_{C1}^{-1})+\rho_{T0}^{-1}+\rho_{T1}^{-1}\). The normalized harmonic variance and every Green--harmonic cross-covariance vanish by the uniform \(L^2\) bound in thm:nested-derivative.

obligation.partial_result:
The corrected weighted-Hodge derivative proves that its entire harmonic component has uniformly bounded cellwise \(L^2(P_g)\) scores, so its normalized variance and its Green cross-covariances vanish.  For the frozen leading response at \(y_j\), direct anisotropic polar integration gives
\[
\int_{h<|z-y_j|<r_0}
\nabla\Gamma_{B(y_j)}(z-y_j)
\nabla\Gamma_{B(y_j)}(z-y_j)^{\mathsf T}\,dz
=\frac{B(y_j)^{-1}}{4\pi\sqrt{\det B(y_j)}}
\log(1/h)+O(1).
\]
The treated-cell local intensity is \(f_{T1}(y_j)\), while each control-cell intensity after multiplication by its leading coefficient is \(\alpha(y_j)f_{T1}(y_j)\).  Independence and \(B=f_{T1}H^{-1}\) therefore force the displayed candidate block \(V_j\).  What remains is the uniform exact-score-to-frozen-score comparison for transformed kernels and moving poles.
